questions.question: Why should roofing hand tools be inspected before use?
options: Damaged tools can cause injury or poor workmanship
questions.explanation:
Hand tools can loosen, crack, dull, or break.
Damaged tools may slip or fail during use.
Inspection helps keep work safe and accurate.

questions.category: B2 — Use Power Tools, Pneumatic Tools, Hot-Air Welding, Induction, and Fuelled Equipment
questions.question: Why should hot-air welder temperature and speed be adjusted together?
questions.explanation:
A strong weld depends on proper heat and travel speed.
Too much or too little heat can damage or weaken seams.
Welds should be tested after completion.

questions.category: B3 — Use Hoisting, Lifting, and Rigging Equipment
questions.question: Why should rigging be rated for the load being lifted?
options: Any rope can lift any load
questions.explanation:
Hoisting equipment has safe working limits.
Overloading rigging can cause dropped loads.
Load weight and rigging rating must be confirmed.

questions.question: Why should ladders be secured when used for roof access?
options: To prevent movement while workers climb
To make ladders harder to use
questions.explanation:
Ladders can shift during use.
Securing them helps prevent falls.
They should also be placed on firm, level ground.

questions.question: Why should hot process equipment temperature be monitored?
options: Overheating can create fire risk and damage materials
questions.explanation:
Hot roofing materials have safe working temperature limits.
Excess heat can increase fire risk.
Temperature control supports safety and quality.
